title: Just Add Salt | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Just Add Salt is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Looking for a spacious home near the beach that’s ideal for gathering with family and friends? Welcome to Just Add Salt, a four-bedroom, four-bathroom retreat in the gated community of Sunrise Beach on the south side of 30A. With room for up to 12 guests, this home offers Gulf views from the balconies, a private pool, and access to the private Sunrise Beach shoreline via two walkovers just a short stroll away. Spend your days on the quiet private beach reserved for the community, where the owner provides four beach chairs for guests to enjoy during their stay. Whether you're relaxing by the pool or taking in the coastal breeze on the balcony, you'll love the blend of comfort and location.Start your mornings with coffee and conversation on the balcony while soaking up the beach view. Inside, the first floor offers 2 twin beds with built-in trundles that sleep four, plus a guest bedroom. Head upstairs to the main living area and settle in with your group on the cozy slipcovered sofas for movie nights. A fireplace adds warmth on cooler evenings. The kitchen is fully equipped with all the essentials including a Keurig, coffee maker, toaster, blender, and microwave to make mealtime a breeze. Gather around the dining table that seats eight, with four more spots at the island. Another guest bedroom with its own balcony and an adjoining bathroom is located on this level.On the top floor, the primary suite offers the best Gulf views, a fireplace, and private balcony, a favorite spot for winding down. There’s also a queen bedroom with its own bathroom and balcony, giving everyone a comfortable place to recharge.Sleeping Arrangements:* 1st FloorBedroom 1: 2 twin beds with 2 trundles, 1 queen bed, TV's, bathroom with combo shower/tub* 2nd FloorBedroom 2: 1 queen bed, TV, bathroom with combo shower/tub* 3rd FloorBedroom 3: 1 queen bed, TV, balcony, bathroom with combo shower/tubBedroom 4: 1 king bed, TV, fireplace, balcony, ensuite bathroomYour stay includes thoughtful extras to make every day easier and more enjoyable. From March through October, four beach chairs and one umbrella are included with your rental, perfect for full, carefree beach days. A 6-seater golf cart is included with your stay, adding comfort and convenience for exploring nearby spots around 30A. Optional pool heating and a private grill at the side of the house are also available, perfect for casual cookouts during your stay.Nearby Attractions:Location is key, and Just Add Salt puts you in the heart of it all. You’ll be just steps from the private beach access in Sunrise Beach, making it easy to enjoy the shoreline whenever you’d like. Spend the day at Gulf Place Town Center, where you can shop, catch live events, or enjoy casual dining. Explore nearby spots like Alvin’s Island for beachwear and souvenirs, grab a slice at Pizza by The Sea, or indulge in treats at Pecan Jack’s Ice Cream. Enjoy live music and craft drinks at Growler Garage, savor seafood and sunset views at Shunk Gulley or Vue on 30A, and grab a cup of coffee from Sunrise Coffee. You’re also just minutes from Local Catch, The Perfect Pig, Pazzo Italiano, Mimmo’s 30A Ristorante Italiano, and Shelby’s Beach Bar and Grill.Your stay at Just Add Salt comes with Xplorie’s top activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 2 cars only.* Golf Carts are permitted.* Private pool can be heated with a fee.* Complimentary beach service: 4 chairs/1 umbrella set up from La Dolce Vita provided March-October (weather permitting).A starter set of amenities is provided: The kitchen includes paper towels, a sponge, dish soap, dishwasher pods, kitchen wipes, trash liners, and laundry pods. Each bathroom has toilet paper, facial and bath soaps, body wash, shampoo, and conditioner. Towels include one body towel and washcloth per guest, plus two hand towels per bathroom.
